Six cells: 1 MAMA CRADLES: seated Mama full body, tiny infant reclined across two forearms, one supports head/back, other hips, baby's own two arms and two legs separate. 2 PAPA HOLDS: seated Papa full body, infant upright nestled against chest, one paw supports hips other upper back, relaxed attentive eye contact. 3 FAMILY SCALE: all four whole separate bodies on same ground plane, Papa and Mama side by side, older PinPin beside them, PomPom seated in low cream supportive nest on floor, clear adult > older child > tiny infant proportion. 4 SITTING TOGETHER: older PinPin seated beside infant's supporting cushion, PinPin slightly leans to show small leaf, mutual gaze; scale difference clear. 5 SIBLING HUG: older PinPin seated beside cushion gently embraces tiny PomPom across shoulders, infant hips/back supported by cushion, both bodies clearly distinct, no squeezing, adult Mama paw may steady cushion only if needed but prefer no extra hand. 6 CAREFUL HANDOFF: Mama and Papa full bodies kneeling facing each other, tiny reclining infant BETWEEN them, receiving Papa's two paws under baby's back and hips while Mama's forearms still support infant; clear four adult arms total, no duplicated paws, believable overlaps and eye lines.
